title: Sunflower Punk Dancer
description: Three sequential poses of a female character with spiky black hair, goggles, and sunflower motifs performing a dynamic dance against a solid green background. She wears a yellow and black punk outfit with a corset belt, frilled skirt, sunflower-decorated stockings, and heavy boots, with a long tail ending in a sunflower.
prompt: A three-panel sequence showing the same anime-style punk girl dancing against a solid bright green background. She has spiky black hair with sunflowers, yellow goggles, a yellow long-sleeve top with black corset belt, frilled yellow skirt, black stockings with yellow sunflower patterns, and yellow combat boots. She has a long curly black tail ending in a sunflower. Dynamic dance poses with expressive face, cartoon illustration style.
